svg.title: Weekly Beats
svg.desc: Weekly Beats, a weekly music battle for a group of friends: drop one song, a rotating Game Master scores every entry blind, climb the ladder and bend the rules with chips. On the right, a real screenshot of the in-game manual showing the weekly cycle from submissions opening to the Monday reveal.

text.tspan: A weekly music battle for your crew.
Drop one song, get scored blind, climb
the ladder, and bend the rules with chips.
